exercises.title: Exercise 1 — rank inside the department, gap to the top, share of payroll
exercises.problemHtml:
For every employee show depNum, empName, empSalary, hang = rank of the salary inside the department (equal salaries share a rank, no gaps), kem_cao_nhat = how much less than the department's best-paid person they earn, and ty_le = their share (%) of the department's payroll as DECIMAL(5,2). Sort by depNum, hang, empSSN.

14 employees, 5 departments, 6 projects, 16 work assignments, 5 dependents. Names are Vietnamese with diacritics; text compares case-insensitively as on SQL Server.

Requirements

  • Three window functions over the same PARTITION BY depNum: DENSE_RANK, MAX, SUM.
  • ty_le = CAST(ROUND(100.0 * empSalary / SUM(empSalary) OVER (…), 2) AS DECIMAL(5,2)).

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT depNum, empName, empSalary,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY depNum ORDER BY empSalary DESC)            AS hang,
       MAX(empSalary) OVER (PARTITION BY depNum) - empSalary                      AS kem_cao_nhat,
       CAST(ROUND(100.0 * empSalary / SUM(empSalary) OVER (PARTITION BY depNum), 2) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS ty_le
FROM tblEmployee
ORDER BY depNum, hang, empSSN;

exercises.problemHtml:
List only the months whose revenue is higher than the previous month's: thang, tien, truoc (previous month), tang (the increase) and ty_trong = the month's share (%) of the total of ALL months, as DECIMAL(5,2). Sort by thang.

solutionCodeJson.code:
WITH t AS (
    SELECT thang, tien,
           LAG(tien) OVER (ORDER BY thang) AS truoc,
           CAST(ROUND(100.0 * tien / SUM(tien) OVER (), 2) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS ty_trong   -- before the WHERE
    FROM DoanhThu
)
SELECT thang, tien, truoc, tien - truoc AS tang, ty_trong
FROM t
WHERE tien > truoc
ORDER BY thang;

WITH RECURSIVE cay AS (
    SELECT empSSN AS goc, empSSN                 -- every employee starts their own tree
    FROM tblEmployee
  UNION ALL
    SELECT c.goc, e.empSSN                       -- one level down
    FROM tblEmployee e
    JOIN cay c ON e.supervisorSSN = c.empSSN
)
SELECT g.empSSN, g.empName, COUNT(*) - 1 AS so_nguoi_duoi
FROM cay
JOIN tblEmployee g ON g.empSSN = cay.goc
GROUP BY g.empSSN, g.empName
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY so_nguoi_duoi DESC, g.empSSN;

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: On SQL Server the same query starts with WITH cay AS (…) — no RECURSIVE — and works the same. With many roots the CTE grows to (employees × depth) rows: fine here, worth an index on supervisorSSN for a real company.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Trên SQL Server cùng câu bắt đầu bằng WITH cay AS (…) — không có RECURSIVE — và chạy y như vậy. Nhiều gốc thì CTE có (số nhân viên × độ sâu) dòng: ổn ở đây, với công ty thật nên có chỉ mục trên supervisorSSN.

solutionCodeJson.code:
WITH x AS (
    SELECT w.proNum, w.empSSN, w.workHours,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.proNum ORDER BY w.workHours DESC) AS rk
    FROM tblWorksOn w
    WHERE w.workHours IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT x.proNum, p.proName, e.empName, x.workHours
FROM x
JOIN tblProject  p ON p.proNum = x.proNum
JOIN tblEmployee e ON e.empSSN = x.empSSN
WHERE x.rk = 1
ORDER BY x.proNum, x.empSSN;

exercises.problemHtml:
For each student return the longest run of consecutive sessions attended: sv, bat_dau, ket_thuc, do_dai. If two runs are equally long, return the earlier one. Sort by sv.

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
WITH d AS (
    SELECT sv, buoi, buoi - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sv ORDER BY buoi) AS nhom   -- same value inside a run
    FROM DiemDanh
), dao AS (
    SELECT sv, MIN(buoi) AS bat_dau, MAX(buoi) AS ket_thuc, COUNT(*) AS do_dai
    FROM d
    GROUP BY sv, nhom
), xh AS (
    SELECT sv, bat_dau, ket_thuc, do_dai,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sv ORDER BY do_dai DESC, bat_dau) AS rn
    FROM dao
)
SELECT sv, bat_dau, ket_thuc, do_dai
FROM xh
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY sv;

exercises.title: Exercise 6 — synchronise a price list with MERGE, safely
exercises.problemHtml:
BangGia(maHang, tenHang, gia, ngayCapNhat) is the shop's price list; GiaMoi(maHang, tenHang, gia) is the supplier's new list. Write dbo.prDongBoGia (no parameters) that, in one MERGE:

  • updates the price (and sets ngayCapNhat to today) only for items whose price really changed;
  • adds new items (ngayCapNhat = today);
  • keeps items the supplier did not mention;
  • returns a report (hanhDong, maHang, gia) with one row per item it changed (OUTPUT $action);
  • is safe when two sessions run it at the same time (no duplicate-key error).

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. MERGE … OUTPUT $action and the HOLDLOCK table hint are SQL Server syntax that the browser grader (PostgreSQL in WASM) cannot run. Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (4 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED). Always run them in this order: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (the course setup, lesson 0.3): open setup.sql → F5; open solution.sql → F5; open check.sql → F5, then read the Messages tab. Or in a terminal inside the folder (sqlcmd ships with SQL Server; otherwise winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • MERGE dbo.BangGia WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t USING dbo.GiaMoi AS s ON …
  • WHEN MATCHED AND t.gia <> s.gia … WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET … OUTPUT $action, inserted.maHang, inserted.gia; — and no NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
BangGia(maHang, tenHang, gia, ngayCapNhat) là bảng giá của cửa hàng; GiaMoi(maHang, tenHang, gia) là bảng giá mới của nhà cung cấp. Viết dbo.prDongBoGia (không tham số) bằng một câu MERGE:

  • cập nhật giá (và đặt ngayCapNhat = hôm nay) chỉ cho mặt hàng thật sự đổi giá;
  • thêm mặt hàng mới (ngayCapNhat = hôm nay);
  • giữ mặt hàng nhà cung cấp không nhắc tới;
  • trả báo cáo (hanhDong, maHang, gia), mỗi mặt hàng được đổi một dòng (OUTPUT $action);
  • an toàn khi hai phiên chạy cùng lúc (không lỗi trùng khoá).

Chạy trên SQL SERVER CỦA BẠN, không chạy trong trình duyệt. MERGE … OUTPUT $action và gợi ý bảng HOLDLOCK là cú pháp SQL Server mà máy chấm trình duyệt (PostgreSQL trong WASM) không chạy được. Trang này không tự chấm: chạy tệp tự kiểm check.sql trên máy bạn, khi nó in ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED thì bấm Tự đánh dấu đã giải.

Cách chạy (Windows hoặc macOS)

Bấm Tải .zip ở khung code rồi giải nén. Thư mục có ba tệp: setup.sql (tạo lại CSDL nháp DBI202_CL với các bảng mẫu), solution.sql (bài làm CỦA BẠN — chỉ sửa tệp này) và check.sql (4 kiểm; in PASS/FAIL từng kiểm và kết thúc bằng ALL 4 CHECKS PASSED). Luôn chạy đúng thứ tự: setup → solution → check.

    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (đăng nhập SQL thì thay -E bằng -U sa -P "<mật khẩu>").
  • macOS (SQL Server trong Docker như bài 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge

-- solution.sql — YOUR answer for: Exercise 6 — synchronise a price list with MERGE, safely
-- Bài làm CỦA BẠN. Run order / thứ tự chạy: setup.sql → solution.sql → check.sql
USE DBI202_CL;
GO
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE dbo.prDongBoGia
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    MERGE dbo.BangGia WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS t        -- HOLDLOCK: the "not matched" check and the INSERT are one unit
    USING dbo.GiaMoi AS s
       ON t.maHang = s.maHang
    WHEN MATCHED AND t.gia <> s.gia THEN          -- only prices that really changed
        UPDATE SET gia = s.gia, ngayCapNhat = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)
    WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN               -- new items
        INSERT (maHang, tenHang, gia, ngayCapNhat) VALUES (s.maHang, s.tenHang, s.gia, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
    -- no WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE: items the supplier did not mention are kept
    OUTPUT $action AS hanhDong, inserted.maHang, inserted.gia;   -- the report
END
